first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A first-person person, with only the hands and parts of the wrists and arms visible, wearing purple patterned gloves and holding Weapon A first, then Weapon B.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The light-gold handgun held by Person A, with an elongated slide and most of the grip obscured by the hand.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The purple-blue pointed knife switched to by Person A, with a dark handle and a transverse guard.

entities.name: white locker group beside the doorway
entities.identification: A row of tall off-white cabinets beside the wide doorway with a white frame, with large red lettering and black graffiti on the doors.

entities.name: wide doorway with a white frame
entities.identification: The light-colored wide doorframe connecting the near locker room to the gray corridor.

entities.name: rear wall with skull graffiti
entities.identification: The light-gray wall at the far end of the corridor with black skull outlines and purple lettering-like graffiti, with an inner doorway on the image-left side.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The dark person in the distant inner doorway, with the head, torso, and separated legs discernible.

entities.name: white muzzle smoke
entities.identification: The diffuse white-gray smoke that appears above and in front of Weapon A and in the upper part of the corridor after firing.

entities.name: light-colored locker-room wall
entities.identification: The near light-beige wall and the wall pillar beside the doorway, with illuminated bright and dark sections.

entities.name: indoor metal grid ceiling
entities.identification: The exposed gray grating, crossbeams, and intersecting supports above the corridor.

entities.name: long overhead light fixture
entities.identification: The slender white illuminated light fixture below the ceiling.

entities.name: gray corridor floor
entities.identification: The gray-blue floor behind the doorway with a yellow boundary line and a dark-gray rectangular cover plate.

entities.name: vertically striped corridor side wall
entities.identification: The gray vertically striped wall panels on the image-right side of the corridor, with a dark border strip at the base and a vertical pipe nearby.

entities.name: green arrow sign
entities.identification: The green horizontal rectangular sign on the corridor side wall, with a white arrow pointing right.

entities.name: scattered white papers in the corridor
entities.identification: The collection of flat white paper pieces on the gray corridor floor.
